composition: Dark smock mill on a brick base at the Spaarne bend · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: De Adriaan stands on the bend of the Spaarne, a dark wooden smock mill with a gallery, set on a tall brick base, with lattice sails over the water. The sky is mainly clear, about 15.7°C, with wind near 9.0 km/h and cloud cover about 49%. The museum is closed at this hour. Teylers and the Grote Markt are outside the frame.
